builds.name: Shuriken Flip E2 ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Shuriken Flip E2 within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Shuriken Flip E2 within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: E2 at rank5 is 0.7*(350+1.0 total AD+1.1 AP) magic damage; AP and MR penetration strengthen the return hit. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya/Banshee add105AP each without mana. Riftmaker converts bonusHP toAP and adds8% damage at full ramp. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR; Shadowflame amplifies eligible low-health magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

kitEvidence.formula: Akali flips backwards as she throws a shuriken, dealing [(70 / 140 / 210 / 280 / 350 + (1) × AD + (1.1) × AP) × (0.3)] magic damage and marking the first enemy or smoke cloud hit. Akali can Recast this once to dash to the marked target, dealing [(70 / 140 / 210 / 280 / 350 + (1) × AD + (1.1) × AP) × (0.7)] magic damage.

builds.name: Perfect Execution: second-dash execution
builds.summary: Investigate high second Perfect Execution dash output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high second Perfect Execution dash output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The R2 helper has 70/140/210 + 0.3 AP minimum magic damage and a maximum of three times that minimum. Missing enemy health increases the result; the extracted helper does not resolve its exact health breakpoint. R1 has a different coefficient and is not part of this score.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. No free permanent stacks. Record actual AD/AP and resists. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 25%, observation 3s. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Stop observed scoring on death and report raw overkill separately. R1 legally cast at least 2.5 seconds before the scored recast; prepare it on a different victim where possible and preserve the stated target health. Record actual R2 multiplier at the loaded target health instead of granting the threefold cap. Riftmaker ramp earned separately.
